# ANALYSIS: Stage-1 Backtest via Autoresearch Grinder

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Running the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder will produce edge_capture and Sharpe metrics for the current engine configuration, allowing validation against OP-16 anchors (top 3 J days) with real-fills.

## Mechanism

Invoke the autoresearch grinder harness (e.g., `python -m backtest.autoresearch.grinder --stage 1`) to compute edge_capture (sum of engine P&L on J winners minus sum of max(0, engine loss on J losers)) and aggregate Sharpe over the full OOS window. Validate real-fills on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) by comparing BS-sim vs real OPRA fills diff < ±20%.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest uses the full 16-month OPRA window (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) as per grinder harness; selection method is systematic grid over parameters; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward and OP-16 anchor gates.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will be computed by grinder).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will be validated on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** worst day loss from J losers, max drawdown from equity curve, blow-up scenario if edge_capture < 771.
6. **Concentration:** will be computed; if top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X.

## Pre-merge gate

Grinder must pass: Stage-1 backtest completion, edge_capture >= 771 (OP-16 floor), Sharpe > 0, real-fills diff < ±20% on top 3 J days, walk-forward OOS positive, sub-window stability.
